title: A Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate HLX43 in Subjects With Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
official: An Open-label, Multi-center, Global Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of HLX43 (Anti-PD-L1 ADC) in Subjects With Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
summary: The study is being conducted to to explore the reasonable dosage and evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of HLX43 (Anti-PD-L1 ADC) in Patients with Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
